pages.title: Spike
pages.description: Creates a spike of dripstone that will damage entities that touch it. Can be augmented with AoE and Pierce to make it wider or taller, with ExtendTime to make it last longer or with Amplify to make it deal more damage. If a spike can't be placed, a falling spike will be summoned instead, which only can be augmented with Amplify to increase the damage it deals based on the height it falls from.
